files.document_title: Williams Western Interstates Spring Shipper Advisory Board Meeting, April 22, 2026, slide 38, Project Aquila
files.what_it_shows: A schematic map of the United States with Utah highlighted and a dot for Eagle Mountain. The text says Williams will build, own and operate power generation facilities and two pipeline laterals, a 19-mile service pipeline from the MountainWest Pipeline system to the power plant and a 1-mile service pipeline from the Kern River Pipeline to the plant. The plant is 520 megawatts in two phases, in service in the second half of 2027 and first half of 2028.

notes: No route map was found, so the oilandgaswatch geometry stays the only geometry for comparison. One useful detail for the comparison: the 19 miles on the sheet is the lateral from the MountainWest Pipeline system to the plant, and there is a separate 1-mile connection from Kern River, so the sheet's length is the MountainWest lateral only. The slide does not say where on the MountainWest system the lateral starts.
